description: Update an Open frame order's editable fields (reference, description, caps, dates, currency, notes). Closed frame orders cannot be edited; use this only for Open frame orders.

end_date.description: Updated end date (YYYY-MM-DD, >= start_date), or omit to clear.

frame_order_id.description: Id of the frame order to update.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

reference.description: New unique reference string for this (org, customer), max 100 chars.

start_date.description: Updated start date (YYYY-MM-DD), or omit to clear.

total_amount.description: Updated contracted amount cap (must be > 0, or omit/null to clear).

total_hours.description: Updated contracted hours cap (must be > 0, or omit/null to clear).

name: update_frame_order
